name: Sebastien
source:
Possessing the ability to shift between the forms of a human and a feline, Sebastien has been the familiar of the Talisko family for generations, providing mentoring and guidance to fresh mages. 
Sensible and rational, he can be serious to a fault, failing to see humor in things. 
He has also an irritable temperament and a sharp tongue, paired with an impudent attitude that easily offend others. 


[From [url=https://wind-chimes-games.itch.io/reanimation-scheme]itch.io[/url]]
